entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. For returns or exchanges, press two. To speak with a sales representative, press three.
Two.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sam. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse. It's just not what I expected.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, it's uh... VF951-4B. I got it a couple of weeks ago.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 15 days ago. Is that correct?
Fifteen days? I guess so. I've been busy. So just email me the label.
Well sir, I'm seeing an issue here. Our return policy is within 14 days of delivery. Since it's been 15 days, the system has automatically flagged this order as ineligible for a refund.
You cannot be serious. It's one day. ONE. You're telling me I'm stuck with this thing over a single day? What kind of policy is that?
I do understand your frustration, and I apologize for the inconvenience. The 14-day window is firm, and unfortunately, I can't process a return once it has passed.
This is unbelievable. So I'm just supposed to accept this? This is why people hate calling customer service.
Sir, I... okay, look. Please hold on. You're right, it is just one day. I am absolutely not supposed to do this, but I'm going to see what I can do.
So you can fix it?

Technically, no. But as a **one-time exception**, I'm going to try and **override the system** for you. Honestly, my **manager would kill me** if he knew I was doing this, but I don't want you to have a bad experience over 24 hours. Just give me a moment.

(sound of typing) ... Okay, it looks like it worked. I've just manually generated a return authorization and sent the prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow. Seriously? You got it through?
I did. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed. It should take about 3-5 business days after we get it.
Oh, man. Thank you. I really, really appreciate that. I was getting so frustrated. Thank you for doing that.
Of course. I'm happy I was able to get it sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Sam. You were a huge help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
